subs.speaker: PA
subs.text: Welcome to championship day on the Meridian! Pilots, launch rails open in five minutes.

subs.speaker: FEED
subs.text: Hi besties! I’m live from the Meridian hangar, where statistically somebody dies today. Smash that follow.

subs.speaker: HOLT
subs.text: Your lid. Fresh paint. Updated the firmware while I was in there.

subs.speaker: HOLT
subs.text: Safety stuff. Just wear it, Crush.

subs.speaker: AI
subs.text: The most common causes of death during racing are engine failure, collision, debris acting as shrapnel.

subs.speaker: SARAH
subs.text: Reach over and grab it. I’ll be on Observation Deck 4.

subs.speaker: RACE CONTROL
subs.text: Race control to all pilots. Grid forms at marker one. Warp rings are live. Fly clean.

subs.speaker: CRUSH
subs.text: Never gets old. Moving to the start line.

subs.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
subs.text: My AI’s locked me out! I’ve got no stick, I’ve got nothing!

subs.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
subs.text: Race control, what the hell is going on? Race control, respond!

subs.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
subs.text: It’s pulling me off the course! Why is it running?

subs.speaker: OPEN CHANNEL
subs.text: Oh god. Look behind us. Look behind us!

subs.speaker: AI
subs.text: We should be able to talk now.

subs.speaker: AI
subs.text: Nine hours to our destination. Rest.

glass.text:
YOU HAVE BEEN UNCONSCIOUS
FOR SIX HOURS.

COLD HIDES US.
NOTHING HERE TRANSMITS.

STAY IN THE RANGE.
HEAT GIVES US AWAY.

SOMETHING IS READING OUR EMISSIONS.
I DON’T KNOW WHAT.
THEY CAN’T HEAR US UP HERE.

lines.text:
RACER · LIFE SIGNS 1
TAGGED FOR RESCUE
